Transportation applications should improve service workflow, measurement, organization, or explanation. Student-fabricated parts here are **non-vehicle, non-safety-critical prototypes** unless an appropriately qualified process says otherwise.

## Project directions

:::: {.ter-project-grid}
::: {.ter-project-card}
### Socket-set service module
<p class="ter-course-code">TTJ2O · Organizer family</p>
Measure one actual socket set and design a portable module that makes size, drive family, missing pieces, and removal order obvious.
<dl><dt>Process</dt><dd>Inventory → measured layout → cardboard trial → rack prototype → carry test</dd><dt>Skills</dt><dd>Diameter measurement, labelling, spacing, workflow, retention</dd><dt>Difficulty / size</dt><dd>Intermediate · one bounded socket family</dd><dt>Material</dt><dd>Plywood or printed inserts in a robust base</dd><dt>Structural</dt><dd>Support mass at the base; verify handle and positive retention</dd><dt>Safety</dt><dd>Keep the module off vehicles and away from moving equipment</dd><dt>Library</dt><dd><a href="../../../teaching-materials/laser-cutting/?technology=transportation&type=tool-holders">Transportation holder kits</a></dd><dt>Lesson</dt><dd><a href="../../03-laser-cutting/06-tool-holder.qmd">Tool Holder</a></dd><dt>Extension</dt><dd>Compare retrieval errors before and after organization</dd></dl>
:::
::: {.ter-project-card}
### Fastener identification station
<p class="ter-course-code">TTJ2O · Gauge family</p>
Build a station that distinguishes nominal shank diameter from screw length and clearly shows the correct datum for each.
<dl><dt>Process</dt><dd>Research standards → exact geometry → test cut → verify → label limitations</dd><dt>Skills</dt><dd>Diameter versus length, units, datums, kerf compensation</dd><dt>Difficulty / size</dt><dd>Introductory–intermediate · under 250 mm wide</dd><dt>Material</dt><dd>Dimensionally stable sheet with high-contrast engraving</dd><dt>Structural</dt><dd>Protect holes and scale edge from impact</dd><dt>Safety</dt><dd>Identification aid only; verify replacement fasteners with service information</dd><dt>Library</dt><dd><a href="../../../teaching-materials/laser-cutting/?technology=transportation&type=jigs-gauges">Fastener and screw gauges</a></dd><dt>Lesson</dt><dd><a href="../../03-laser-cutting/03-measure-place.qmd">Measure + Place</a></dd><dt>Extension</dt><dd>Add a decision guide for diameter, pitch, grade, and length</dd></dl>
:::
::: {.ter-project-card}
### Electrical-diagnosis teaching board
<p class="ter-course-code">Senior TTJ · Display family</p>
Create a low-voltage board that lets students trace a simplified lighting or sensor circuit and identify test points.
<dl><dt>Process</dt><dd>Schematic → panel layout → insulated mounting → continuity test → peer explanation</dd><dt>Skills</dt><dd>Schematic reading, labels, wire routing, test sequence</dd><dt>Difficulty / size</dt><dd>Intermediate · tabletop panel</dd><dt>Material</dt><dd>Plywood/acrylic panel, low-voltage components, protected wiring</dd><dt>Structural</dt><dd>Strain-relieve leads and cover exposed terminals</dd><dt>Safety</dt><dd>Use current-limited extra-low voltage only; never connect to a vehicle safety system</dd><dt>Library</dt><dd><a href="../../../teaching-materials/laser-cutting/?technology=transportation&type=core-geometry">Mounting geometry</a></dd><dt>Lesson</dt><dd><a href="../../02-digital-design/02-vector-geometry.qmd">Vector Geometry</a></dd><dt>Extension</dt><dd>Add one documented fault for diagnosis</dd></dl>
:::
::::
